pan-seared lemon garlic chicken.title: Pan-Seared Lemon Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, butterflied or pounded to an even thickness (about ¾ inch)
1 lemon (half for juice, half for slices/wedges)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
(Optional: a splash of water or chicken broth for a pan sauce)
pan-seared lemon garlic chicken.instructions:
1. Prepare Chicken: If your chicken breasts are thick, butterfly them or pound them to an even ¾-inch thickness. Season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
2. Heat Skillet: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
3. Sear Chicken: Carefully place the chicken breasts in the hot skillet. Sear for 5-7 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C).
4. Add Garlic & Lemon: In the last 2 minutes of cooking, add the minced garlic to the skillet, stirring it around the chicken. Squeeze the juice of half a lemon over the chicken. If you like, you can also add a few thin lemon slices to the pan to warm through.
5. Create Pan Sauce (Optional): If desired, you can add a small splash of water or chicken broth to the pan after the chicken is cooked, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan to create a quick sauce.
6. Serve: Remove chicken from the skillet and let rest for a few minutes before serving. Drizzle with the pan sauce and serve with fresh lemon wedges.
pan-seared lemon garlic chicken.notes: Quick, flavorful, and perfect for a weeknight dinner!
